title: ListEmail - Data API
description: Represents a list email sent from Salesforce, or sent from Account Engagement and synced to Salesforce. When the list email is sent, the recipients are generated by combining recipients in ListEmailIndividualRecipients and ListEmailRecipientSource. Duplicate and other invalid recipients are removed. The result is the recipients sent any given list email. ListEmail has a one-to-many relationship with ListEmailRecipientSource and ListEmailIndividualRecipient. This object is available in API version 41.0 and later.

ActionCadenceStepId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ActionCadenceStepId.description: The ID of the action cadence step that generated a list email record. Used for automated emails in Sales Engagement. Users must have the Sales Engagement Cadence Creator or Sales Engagement User permission enabled. Available in API version 53.0 and later.

CampaignId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CampaignId.description: The ID of the related campaign. This is a relationship field. Available in API version 42.0 and later.

CcAddress.description: The list of carbon copy (CC) addresses set on the generated emails. Multiple addresses are separated by commas. Available in API version 67.0 and later.

ClickThroughRate.description: The percentage of visitors who click links contained in emails delivered (sent minus bounces) to them. Multiple clicks for a same link are counted. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

ClickToOpenRatio.description: The number of unique clicks divided by unique HTML opens. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

DeliveryRate.description: The percentage of the emails that were delivered compared to the number that bounced (soft and hard). Note: this data includes emails that were delivered to the recipient's spam folder. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

EmailContentId.description: The ID of the email content record associated with the list email.To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set. Available in API version 50.0 or later.

FromAddress.description: Read-only except when the list email is in a draft state. Validated against user’s addresses.

FromName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
FromName.description: Read-only except when the list email is in a draft state. Validated against user’s addresses. This field is null for emails sent from Account Engagement.

HasAttachment.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
HasAttachment.description: Read-only. Defaulted on create and update. Value is true if the list email has an attachment. This field is null for emails sent from Account Engagement.

HtmlBody.description: The body of the list email. This field is null for emails sent from Account Engagement. List emails can contain up to 32,000 characters for the body. These limits include visible characters and other characters in the email, including markup.

IsEmailArchiveRequired.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsEmailArchiveRequired.description: Indicates whether email archiving is required. Available in API version 67.0 and later.

IsSyntheticCcEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsSyntheticCcEnabled.description: Indicates whether synthetic carbon copy (CC) is enabled. Available in API version 67.0 and later.

IsTracked.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsTracked.description: Indicates if email tracking was on when the list email was sent. This field is blank for emails sent from Account Engagement and synced to Salesforce. This field is null for emails sent from Account Engagement. Available in API version 44.0 and later.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp that indicates when the current user last viewed a record that is related to this list email. This field is null for emails sent from Account Engagement.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed. This field is null for emails sent from Account Engagement.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: Read-only except when the list email is in a draft state.

OpenRate.description: The percentage of unique HTML opens compared to the total number of emails delivered (sent minus bounces). To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

OptOutRate.description: The percentage of users that have opted out compared to the total number of emails sent. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: References Group and User. This field is null for emails sent from Account Engagement. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

ProgramName.description: The name of an Engagement Studio program where an automated email originates. Reserved for future use. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set. Available in API version 46.0 and later.

RelatedToId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
RelatedToId.description: The ID of the related record. Supported related records include Case, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Product2, and User. Available in API version 60.0 and later.
RelatedToId.refers_to: Case, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Product2, User

ReplyToName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ReplyToName.description: The name associated with the reply-to address for the list email. Available in API version 67.0 and later.

ScheduledDate.description: Read-only. If null and Status is set to Scheduled`defaults to created time.

SentVia.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
SentVia.description: Indicates whether the email was sent from Salesforce or Account Engagement. Valid values: Distributed Marketing– Available in API 66.0 Messaging Service Pardot Salesforce– Default To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

SpamComplaintRate.description: The percentage of spam complaints compared to the total number of emails sent. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: Read-only except when the list email is in a draft state. Changing the status to Scheduled causes the list email to be sent. Valid values: Draft Scheduled Sent Limit Error Canceled Running

Subject.description: Read-only except when the list email is in a draft state. This field is null for emails sent from Account Engagement. List emails can contain up to 3,000 characters for the subject. These limits include visible characters and other characters in the email, including markup.

TextBody.description: Read-only except when the list email is in a draft state. This field is null for emails sent from Account Engagement.

TotalDelivered.description: The total number of emails minus hard and soft bounces. Note: this data includes emails that were delivered to the recipient's spam folder. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

TotalHardBounced.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalHardBounced.description: The total number of emails that permanently bounced back to the sender because the address is invalid. A hard bounce can occur because the domain name doesn't exist or because the recipient is unknown. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

TotalOpens.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalOpens.description: The total number of times a prospect’s email client loaded the images in the HTML version of the email. We also record an open if the prospect clicks a link within the HTML or text email without downloading images. A click indicates that they viewed the message. Some email clients (Outlook, Apple Mail, Thunderbird) don’t display images by default. Account Engagement counts an open each time the images load. To access this field. users need the Sales Engagement User permission set or your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

TotalOutOfOffice.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalOutOfOffice.description: The total number of replies received with an out-of-office message. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the Salesforce Engage permission set.

TotalReplies.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalReplies.description: The total number of replies received. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the Salesforce Engage permission set.

TotalSent.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalSent.description: Read-only. The total number of list emails sent, including bounced, opted-out, and invalid To: addresses.

TotalSoftBounced.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalSoftBounced.description: The total number of times a recipient’s mail server acknowledged the email, but returned it to the sender. Sometimes it is because the recipient's mailbox is full or the mail server is temporarily unavailable. A soft bounce message can sometimes be deliverable at another time. After 5 soft bounces, Account Engagement opts the prospect out of emails. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

TotalSpamComplaints.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalSpamComplaints.description: The total number of prospects that reported the email as spam. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

TotalTrackedLinkClicks.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalTrackedLinkClicks.description: The number of times prospects clicked a link in the email. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

Type.description: The type of email sent: list email or automated email. Reserved for future use. o access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set. This field is available in API version 46.0 and later.

UniqueClickThroughRate.description: The percentage of visitors who clicked a link contained in an email. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

UniqueOpens.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
UniqueOpens.description: The number of prospects who loaded the images in the HTML version of the email. The Unique Opens category counts each recipient one time only, even if the prospect loaded images several times. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

UniqueOptOuts.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
UniqueOptOuts.description: Unique opt-outs represent the total number of prospects that have clicked the link to unsubscribe or opted out of all emails in the Email Preference Center. These prospects are removed from future email sends. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

UniqueReplies.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
UniqueReplies.description: The total number of unique replies. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the Salesforce Engage permission set. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later.

UniqueTrackedLinkClicks.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
UniqueTrackedLinkClicks.description: The number of times a prospect clicked a link in the email. This metric doesn’t include multiple clicks of the same link. To access this field, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.

associated_objects:
This object has these associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **ListEmailChangeEvent (API version 44.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **ListEmailOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **ListEmailShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
